answer_to_was_mppi_never_allowed_to_try.first_g2_event: For the first raw observation1683, the recorded complete ESDF acquisition was already after the slow stop/ABORT. Before that MPPI repeatedly delivered nominal with old-complete-map external clearance~0.18m>0.12m intervention threshold. Thus there is no observed overlap of this new observation and a still-valid native reference for sampled avoidance before the first stop.
answer_to_was_mppi_never_allowed_to_try.not_global_claim: Do not extend this to all cycles: after replacement native trajectories, three whole_body_fallback evaluations occurred17:46:01.609,01.694,04.434 and failed at t0. Other G4 episodes include perception timeouts and one planning deadline. No successful sampled-avoidance delivery appears in G2/G4.
answer_to_was_mppi_never_allowed_to_try.source_time_limit: Nominal String status and abort messages without headers use receiver times. Map h17 is exporter acquisition ROS time; stop logs use header source time. A nominal status received53.366 after ABORT reception53.352 cannot by itself prove stale command execution after cancellation; callback/transport receipt order is not actuator execution order.

actual_vs_reference.confirmed_trigger: future_scan of native reference, not actual_state hard-collision branch. PolyTrajOptimizer reads traj.getPos(t)/getCarAngle(t), then MMConfig checks raw live occupancy with physical sphere radius+one voxel.
actual_vs_reference.actual_check: Actual-state branch uses measured feedback pose and ESDF surface gap<0.01m; no actual-hard-collision log observed in this first window. Its ESDF does not yet contain the newest raw observation1683, so absence of that log cannot certify actual clearance against1683.
actual_vs_reference.missing: No same-generation raw query for both actual pose and the offending reference pose was recorded. Reference/actual yaw discrepancy may affect which body spheres intersect; cannot conclude it was merely a reference-deviation false stop, nor confirmed current physical collision.

deployed_cooperation_boundary.confirmed: fast_to_slow_prefix_enabled=False; MPPI publishes cmd_vel, joint command, enable/fault/status/visualization, with no approved-prefix publisher. FSM subscribes measured odom/joints, trajectory progress and tracking_fault; no MPPI prefix/candidate handoff subscriber. The slow collision scan continues to inspect native reference.
deployed_cooperation_boundary.not_proven: No approved avoidance maneuver was observed before this first stop, so it is false to describe this event as slow layer discarding an already-approved MPPI detour.

core_points.minimal_fix_boundary: Preserve current actual hard-collision, immediate-risk, input-validity and cancellation guards. Distinguish a future/reference-only planning warning from actual unavoidable collision before introducing a bounded MPPI chance. That chance must see the newest collision generation and validate its actual swept prefix; do not simply ignore ACTION_ABORT, extend TTL, or keep following a stale reference. Prefix handoff is an explicit missing feature, not evidence for wholesale two-layer redesign.
core_points.turning_caveat: Raw distance accumulates base xy displacement only; pure yaw contributes0, so15cm linear stop criterion is conservative for turn-only motions. This is a policy mismatch to review with rotational swept-body risk; observed first TTC0.05s prevents declaring the stop unnecessary from the xy metric alone.

core_points.title: G2动态预测为空，不等于实时占据为空；尚未证明tracker识别错误
core_points.classification: Correct separation of sensing products; no demonstrated tracker bug. The word dynamic in raw collision logs is misleading if interpreted as confirmed moving person.
evidence: G2 has454 dynamic_points messages, all empty. Runtime tracker log17:45:52.933:3confirmed clusters, motion_qualified0, nonmoving_confirmed3, publish=yes.
getDynamicObstacleDistance checks occupied live voxels that do not match nearby prior-static voxels; it does not require a tracked moving object or point-flow velocity.
Raw-live layer and Complete ESDF remain safety sources when qualified dynamic point flow is empty. Therefore454empty messages do not justify ignoring live collisions.
The nearest low live cell from later failures is not traced to person/self return with certainty; that uncertainty is retained and no further provenance work is included.
core_points.minimal_fix_boundary: Clarify logs/diagnostics as live occupancy collision versus motion-qualified predicted collision. Change tracker qualification only with corresponding source evidence; do not force arbitrary residual or static clusters into motion prediction to make avoidance appear active.

core_points.title: 初始状态进入5cm规划带时，全候选t0拒绝是正确执行当前规则，但系统缺少恢复闭环
core_points.classification: The candidate rejection is not a solver bug. The deployment has an unresolved policy/recovery gap: FSM tolerates measured pose outside1cm hard-stop threshold while MPPI requires the entire candidate including t0 outside5cm planning clearance.
evidence: 17:46:01.609,01.694,04.434 actually attempted whole_body_fallback; structured and random candidates failed, first external violation time0.0s. Therefore it is inaccurate to claim MPPI never sampled anywhere in G2.
Matched map/body geometry shows physical-model surface clearance31.6–39.3mm but planning gap-10.7 to-18.4mm at initial state. Arm clearance438–542mm and configuration gap+3mm.

MPPI adds resolution0.05m to47fixed sphere radii; evaluate prepends states[:,0], then requires every checked gap>=0. Any candidate shares that same invalid starting sample, so larger sampling cannot resolve it.

Perception-stop episodes in G4 are independent safety reactions: five DepthLost stops with intervening recoveries, plus one raw-live near-collision stop. They should not be diagnosed as this t0 problem or continuous map outage.
core_points.minimal_fix_boundary: Keep ordinary candidates strictly validated. Explicitly choose and validate how to handle a physically clear but planning-margin-violating initial state; this requires a bounded recovery policy or an intentional safe hold with a recoverable planner path. Do not merely omit t0, remove5cm clearance, increase samples, or auto-clear tracking fault. Existing evidence proves the dead end under current criteria, not that a safe escape exists.
